mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, target_dept AS targetDept, weight, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_triage_rule ORDER BY weight DESC, update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_triage_rule (keyword, target_dept, weight) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{targetDept}, #{weight})
mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue FROM sys_ai_config WHERE config_key = #{key}
